reportTitle: 急性胸痛自救用药后症状不缓解的时间阈值与升级路径：现行指南界定的证据基础与一致性分析

claims.claim: 经开放获取综述转述的ACCF/AHA指南文本（稳定型缺血性心脏病）规定硝酸甘油自救方案：舌下含服0.3～0.6mg，多数患者5分钟内缓解；如需追加剂量，应每5分钟1次，15分钟内最大剂量≤1.2mg；在此期间若症状不缓解，患者应立即寻求医疗救助。
claims.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
claims.supportQuote: Most patients respond within 5 minutes of taking one to two sublingual dose(s) of 0.3–0.6 mg each. … If additional doses are necessary, they should be taken at 5-minute intervals for a maximum dose of ≤1.2 mg within 15 minutes. During this timeframe, if relief does not occur, the patient should seek immediate medical attention.
claims.applicability: 国际指南文本（ACCF/AHA稳定型缺血性心脏病），经开放获取综述（Drug Des Devel Ther 2015）逐字转述
claims.uncertainty: 该指南条文以综述附表形式转述，非ACCF/AHA原始PDF逐字核验；综述为同行评议开放获取文献，已保存全文

claims.claim: 经开放获取综述转述的2011 ACCF/AHA更新文本（UA/NSTEMI管理）对疑似ACS患者的自救指令：已处方硝酸甘油者，出现胸部不适时先含服不超过1剂；若含服1剂后5分钟内无缓解或疼痛加重，患者或家属/照护者应立即呼叫9-1-1以获得急救服务，而不是先追加硝酸甘油。
claims.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
claims.supportQuote: Patients with suspected acute coronary syndrome who have been prescribed nitroglycerin previously should initially take no more than one nitroglycerin dose sublingually in response to chest discomfort/pain. If no relief occurs, or if pain worsens 5 minutes after taking one nitroglycerin dose, the patient or family member/friend/caregiver should call 9-1-1 immediately to access emergency medical services before taking additional nitroglycerin.
claims.applicability: 国际指南文本（2011 ACCF/AHA UA/NSTEMI更新），适用于疑似ACS的已处方硝酸甘油患者
claims.uncertainty: 以综述转述的指南条文为证据（全文已保存），非ACCF/AHA原始PDF逐字核验；急救号码按辖区本地化（中国为120）

claims.claim: 经开放获取综述转述的AHA/ACC对UA/NSTEMI抗缺血治疗的Class I推荐（证据级别C）：持续缺血性不适的患者应舌下含服硝酸甘油0.4mg，每5分钟1次，共3次；此后应评估静脉硝酸甘油的需要（除非有禁忌）。
claims.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
claims.supportQuote: Class I = patients with unstable angina or non–ST-elevation myocardial infarction (UA/NSTEMI) with ongoing ischemic discomfort should receive sublingual nitroglycerin (0.4 mg) every 5 minutes for a total of three doses. Thereafter, these patients should be assessed for the need of intravenous nitroglycerin, unless contraindicated (Level of Evidence: C).
claims.applicability: 国际指南文本（UA/NSTEMI院内抗缺血治疗），经开放获取综述转述
claims.uncertainty: 以综述转述的指南条文为证据（全文已保存）；推荐级别“Class I，Level C”随引文原文保留

claims.claim: 经开放获取综述转述的ESC稳定型冠状动脉疾病指南文本：心绞痛发作时患者应静坐休息并舌下含服硝酸甘油（0.3～0.6mg），每5分钟1次，直至疼痛缓解或15分钟内最大剂量1.2mg。
claims.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
claims.supportQuote: When angina starts, the patient should rest in the sitting posture (standing promotes syncope and lying down enhances venous return and heart work) and take sublingual nitroglycerin (0.3 to 0.6 mg) every 5 minutes until the pain subsides or a maximum of 1.2 mg has been taken within 15 minutes.
claims.applicability: 国际指南文本（ESC稳定型冠状动脉疾病），经开放获取综述转述
claims.uncertainty: 以综述转述的指南条文为证据（全文已保存）；适用于心绞痛发作场景而非未分型急性胸痛

claims.claim: 经开放获取综述转述的临床定义：心绞痛发作对短效硝酸甘油无反应（通常定义为每5分钟1次、最多3次后胸部不适无改善），应视为可能急性心肌梗死，需要立即医疗评估与处理。
claims.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
claims.supportQuote: an angina attack that does not respond to short-acting nitroglycerin (generally defined as a lack of improvement in chest discomfort following up to three short-acting nitrates every 5 minutes) should be regarded as consistent with a possible acute MI requiring immediate medical attention and evaluation.
claims.applicability: 急性胸痛患者升级处置的临床界定（综述陈述的通行定义）
claims.uncertainty: 该定义来自开放获取综述正文（全文已保存），是对通行临床定义的转述而非随机试验检验

claims.claim: “时间即心肌”原则：缺血持续时间直接决定梗死面积与临床结局；每分钟延迟与死亡率增加、梗死面积增大及心力衰竭风险增高相关（2025年开放获取综述，J Cardiovasc Dev Dis）。
claims.sourceTitle: The Irreversible March of Time: Ischemic Delay and Impact on Outcomes in ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: The fundamental principle of modern STEMI care—“Time is Muscle”—establishes that ischemic duration directly determines infarct size and clinical outcomes. Each minute of delay correlates with increased mortality, larger infarcts, and a higher risk of heart failure development.
claims.applicability: STEMI（及急性冠脉闭塞）救治的时间依赖原理
claims.uncertainty: 综述性陈述，引用多项原始证据；“每分钟”为定性表述，量化关系见CLM-007/008

claims.claim: 每30分钟再灌注延迟使1年死亡风险增加7.5%（2025年开放获取综述引用的定量数据）。
claims.sourceTitle: The Irreversible March of Time: Ischemic Delay and Impact on Outcomes in ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: Quantitatively, each 30 min reperfusion delay increases one-year mortality risk by 7.5%
claims.applicability: STEMI直接PCI人群的再灌注延迟-死亡关系（综述引用的定量数据）
claims.uncertainty: 该数字由综述转述其引用的原始队列分析（De Luca等）；未对原始论文全文逐字核验，但综述为开放获取全文且明确标注该定量结论

claims.claim: 门球时间与院内死亡的调整关系呈非线性连续升高：30分钟时3.0%、60分钟时3.5%、90分钟时4.3%、150分钟时7.0%（2025年开放获取综述引用的登记研究数据）。
claims.sourceTitle: The Irreversible March of Time: Ischemic Delay and Impact on Outcomes in ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: adjusted in-hospital mortality rises progressively: from 3.0% at 30 min to 3.5% at 60 min, 4.3% at 90 min, and 7.0% at 150 min
claims.applicability: STEMI接受直接PCI人群（登记研究数据，综述转述）
claims.uncertainty: 数据为综述转述的登记研究（NCDR分析）结果，非本研究直接复算；观察性证据存在残余混杂

claims.claim: 指南设定再灌注质量目标：门到溶栓（door-to-needle）≤30分钟、门到球囊（door-to-balloon）≤90分钟（2025年开放获取综述）。
claims.sourceTitle: The Irreversible March of Time: Ischemic Delay and Impact on Outcomes in ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: Guidelines establish quality targets of door-to-needle ≤ 30 min and door-to-balloon ≤ 90 min
claims.applicability: STEMI院内再灌注时间目标（指南设定，综述转述）
claims.uncertainty: 综述未指明具体指南文件名称；具体指南条文的原始出处需在原指南全文核验

claims.claim: 国际指南（ACC/AHA与ESC，含2023更新）将门球时间（door-to-balloon，又称door-to-device）定义为患者到达急诊至梗死相关动脉首次球囊扩张的时间，并建议该间隔在至少90%的合格患者中不超过90分钟（2026年开放获取审计文献）。
claims.sourceTitle: Achieving door-to-balloon time ≤ 90 minutes in ST-elevation myocardial infarction: a retrospective clinical audit from a tertiary care centre in India
claims.supportQuote: International guidelines from the American College of Cardiology (ACC), American Heart Association (AHA), and European Society of Cardiology (ESC – including the 2023 update) define the door-to-balloon (D2B) time equivalently termed door-to-device time as the interval from the patient’s arrival at the emergency department (ED) to first balloon inflation in the infarct-related artery. These guidelines recommend that this interval should not exceed 90 min in at least 90% of eligible patients.
claims.applicability: STEMI直接PCI的院内心肌再灌注时间目标（国际指南设定）
claims.uncertainty: 该表述来自2026年开放获取审计文献对国际指南的概述，非指南原文PDF逐字核验；同时确认ESC 2023更新为现行ESC ACS文件的一部分

claims.claim: 2025 AHA/ACC《急性冠脉综合征患者管理指南》已发布，未正式采用OMI/NOMI术语（2025年开放获取综述转述）。
claims.sourceTitle: The Irreversible March of Time: Ischemic Delay and Impact on Outcomes in ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: the newly released 2025 AHA/ACC Guideline for the Management of Patients With Acute Coronary Syndromes did not formally adopt the OMI/NOMI terminology
claims.applicability: 现行AHA/ACC ACS管理指南的版本确认（转述）
claims.uncertainty: 该指南全文未在本环境中保存，其硝酸甘油自我处置阈值的原文未逐字核验；本主张仅确认其发布与术语立场

claims.claim: 症状发作至首次医疗接触（FMC）是总缺血时间中最长且变异最大的组成部分；中位患者决策延迟约100分钟，约占院前延迟的60%（2025年开放获取综述）。
claims.sourceTitle: The Irreversible March of Time: Ischemic Delay and Impact on Outcomes in ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: The interval from symptom onset to first medical contact (FMC) consistently represents the longest and most variable component of total ischemic time. Median patient decision delay approximates 100 min, constituting nearly 60% of pre-hospital delay.
claims.applicability: STEMI总缺血时间的构成（患者层面延误为主）
claims.uncertainty: 综述汇总多项研究的定量结论；不同地区与系统间存在差异

claims.claim: 速效救心丸（SJP）为由川芎（Chuanxiong）与冰片（Borneol）活性成分组成的专利中成药，可增加冠脉血流量、改善心肌细胞缺氧并缓解心绞痛（与硝酸甘油作用类似），在中国中西结合治疗心绞痛中被常用（开放获取试验方案，Trials 2021）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: Suxiao Jiuxin Pill (SJP, produced by Tianjin Zhongxin Pharmaceutical Group Co, Ltd.) is a patented drug made of active ingredients from Chuanxiong and Borneol, and it has the effect of regulating Qi and promoting blood circulation. SJP can increase coronary blood flow, improve myocardial cell hypoxia, and relieve angina pectoris similar to nitroglycerin
claims.applicability: 中国；稳定型心绞痛的补充治疗场景
claims.uncertainty: 该背景信息来自开放获取试验方案；速效救心丸在中国急性胸痛场景的自我用药时间阈值未在此文献中界定

claims.claim: 速效救心丸治疗稳定型心绞痛的随机、双盲、安慰剂对照、多中心试验方案：拟纳入324例慢性稳定型心绞痛（气滞血瘀证）患者，试验组接受速效救心丸（5粒/次，每日3次）加常规治疗共24周；方案同时规定心绞痛难以忍受时可舌下含服硝酸甘油0.5mg。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: The trial will enroll 324 participants with chronic stable angina (Qi Stagnation and Blood Stasis syndrome). All participants will have received the conventional therapy of chronic stable angina. Participants will be randomized into two groups, conventional therapy plus SJP group and conventional therapy plus placebo group. Eligible participants will receive either SJP or placebo (five pills administered orally, three times daily) in addition to conventional treatment for 24 weeks. … nitroglycerin 0.5 mg can be taken sublingually when angina pectoris is intolerable
claims.applicability: 中国；稳定型心绞痛试验设计场景
claims.uncertainty: 为试验方案（protocol）而非结果报告；速效救心丸5粒/次为试验剂量；该方案确认在常规治疗基础上同步使用硝酸甘油0.5mg舌下含服的应急方案

claims.claim: 英国NHS官方患者指导：突发胸部疼痛或不适且不缓解（可为挤压/压迫感、烧灼感或消化不良样）应立即呼叫急救（999），因为你可能正在发生心脏病发作，需要立即住院治疗。
claims.supportQuote: ## Immediate action required: Call 999 if: you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away – the pain can feel like squeezing or pressure inside your chest, burning or indigestion … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 英国（急救号码999）；原则适用于其他医疗系统（中国为120）
claims.uncertainty: 急救号码需按辖区本地化（中国为120）；官方页面为2023-08-08审阅版本

claims.claim: 当预期FMC至开通（device）时间超过120分钟时（按ESC指南），药物-介入（pharmaco-invasive）策略——早期溶栓后2～24小时内常规造影——是重要的替代方案（2025年开放获取综述）。
claims.sourceTitle: The Irreversible March of Time: Ischemic Delay and Impact on Outcomes in ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
claims.supportQuote: When anticipated FMC-to-device time exceeds 120 min per ESC guidelines, the pharmaco-invasive strategy—early fibrinolysis followed by routine angiography within 2–24 h—provides a crucial alternative.
claims.applicability: 无法在120分钟内完成直接PCI场景的再灌注策略（ESC指南，综述转述）
claims.uncertainty: 以综述转述的ESC指南内容为证据；ESC指南原始条文未在本环境中逐字核验

claims.claim: AHA/ACC体系、ESC体系与患者层面急救指导在“硝酸甘油重复给药方案与升级动作”上高度一致：5分钟间隔重复、最多3次（或15分钟内≤1.2mg）、症状不缓解即升级为呼叫急救/立即就医——NHS患者指导同样要求胸痛不缓解立即呼叫急救。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Role of short-acting nitroglycerin in the management of ischemic heart disease
supportingSources.supportQuote: If additional doses are necessary, they should be taken at 5-minute intervals for a maximum dose of ≤1.2 mg within 15 minutes. During this timeframe, if relief does not occur, the patient should seek immediate medical attention.

## Immediate action required: Call 999 if: you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.

claims.applicability: 跨国/跨体系患者自救阈值的一致性判断
claims.uncertainty: AHA/ACC与ESC条文均经开放获取综述转述（全文已保存），非其原始指南PDF逐字核验；中国指南条文未在本环境中全文核验

claims.claim: “时间即心肌”的定量与系统证据一致：每30分钟再灌注延迟使1年死亡风险增加7.5%、门球时间与院内死亡呈非线性连续关系（90分钟时4.3%）、国际指南（ACC/AHA与ESC，含2023更新）设定门球时间≤90分钟且至少90%合格患者达标的目标。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: The Irreversible March of Time: Ischemic Delay and Impact on Outcomes in ST-Segment Elevation Myocardial Infarction
supportingSources.supportQuote: Quantitatively, each 30 min reperfusion delay increases one-year mortality risk by 7.5%

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Achieving door-to-balloon time ≤ 90 minutes in ST-elevation myocardial infarction: a retrospective clinical audit from a tertiary care centre in India
supportingSources.supportQuote: These guidelines recommend that this interval should not exceed 90 min in at least 90% of eligible patients

claims.applicability: STEMI再灌注时间目标的证据一致性判断
claims.uncertainty: 定量数字为开放获取综述转述的观察性研究结果；门球-死亡关系的非线性与“达标即足够”的简单化解读相悖（见报告讨论）

claims.claim: 从指南剂量方案推算的“升级行动时点”：按0.4mg/次、每5分钟1次、共3次（AHA/ACC UA/NSTEMI方案）执行，完成3次含服约需10～15分钟（第1次于t=0，第2次于t=5min，第3次于t=10min，若计满5分钟评估间隔则至t=15min）；3次后症状仍不缓解即达到“可能急性心肌梗死、需立即医疗评估”的界值，此后不得再自行追加硝酸甘油。
claims.method: 剂量-时间乘积：3次×5分钟间隔=10～15分钟窗口；把AHA/ACC“0.4mg每5分钟共3次”的剂量方案与综述定义的“3次后无改善=可能急性心梗”的界值相衔接，得到升级行动时点约在首剂后10～15分钟。
claims.assumptions: 单次剂量取0.4mg（指南方案）；间隔5分钟；患者按方案执行且无禁忌（低血压、右室梗死、PDE5抑制剂等）。
claims.sensitivity: 若按0.6mg/次（ESC/ACCF/AHA稳定型方案），2次即接近1.2mg上限、窗口约5～10分钟；若按0.3mg/次则可4次、窗口约15～20分钟；对单次剂量选择敏感，但“达到剂量上限后必须升级、不得无限重复”的方向不变。
claims.applicability: 硝酸甘油自救方案的行动边界（剂量约束推论）
claims.uncertainty: 该时点为剂量约束的算术推论，非指南明示数字；实际执行中“呼叫急救优先、自救在等待急救期间进行”仍为首要原则

claims.claim: 自救观察延误的相对死亡风险边界：以“每30分钟再灌注延迟使1年死亡风险增加7.5%”作对数线性外推，每5分钟约+1.2%（RR≈1.012）；指南允许的最长自救观察窗约15分钟（3剂）对应约+3.7%。
claims.assumptions: 观察性效应在5～15分钟短延迟区间呈对数线性；效应可从“再灌注延迟”迁移至“自救-呼叫延迟”；以1年死亡风险为代理。
claims.sensitivity: 综述指出心肌可挽救面积的损失在发病后2～3小时最为剧烈（非线性），真实短延迟效应可能强于线性外推值，故本估计偏保守；若以急性期事件风险替代1年死亡风险，幅度可能更高。
claims.applicability: 量化每次5分钟自救观察循环的相对风险成本；不改变实践指令
claims.uncertainty: 外推超出原始数据直接观测的延迟区间；观察性证据存在残余混杂；该估计为推导值，不得进入实际处置建议
